ticket.title: [EPIC] Login Module — E-Commerce Application
ticket.body:
<!-- aisdlc-key: SPEC-20260720-login-module::epic::login-module -->
<!-- aisdlc-hash: d009f83343ed747b -->

Foundational authentication layer (registration, login, protected dashboard, logout) for the e-commerce app. React+Vite frontend (port 5173) and FastAPI backend (port 8000) with SQLite, bcrypt password hashing, and HS256 JWTs (30-min expiry). This epic unblocks all downstream authenticated features.

**Spec-ID:** SPEC-20260720-login-module
**Spec:** `docs/aisdlc/specs/2026-07-20-login-module-design.md`

## Epic-level Definition of Done
- [ ] All 6 stories below are complete and closed
- [ ] Backend `pytest` suite passes with 0 failures
- [ ] Frontend `vitest` suite passes with 0 failures
- [ ] E2E happy path (register -> login -> dashboard -> logout) passes
- [ ] API contract (status codes + response shapes) matches the spec exactly
- [ ] `.env` and `ecomm.db` are gitignored; no committed secrets
- [ ] CORS restricted to `http://localhost:5173`
- [ ] No partially-implemented out-of-scope features left in committed code

## Child Stories (build-dependency order)
- [ ] #2 [Infra] Project scaffolding & config
- [ ] #3 [Backend] Data layer & auth utilities
- [ ] #4 [Backend] Auth endpoints with error handling
- [ ] #5 [Frontend] Scaffolding & API client
- [ ] #6 [Frontend] Auth pages
- [ ] #7 [QA] Testing & verification

ticket.title: [Infra] Project scaffolding & config
ticket.body:
<!-- aisdlc-key: SPEC-20260720-login-module::story::project-scaffolding-config -->
<!-- aisdlc-hash: 8d2bd4478b3b4dcd -->

Establish the monorepo skeleton, dependency manifests, environment config, and CORS so backend and frontend code can be built on a stable foundation. Security-sensitive files must be gitignored **before** any backend code is written (Risk R4).

**Spec-ID:** SPEC-20260720-login-module
**Depends on:** none

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Monorepo layout created: `frontend/` and `backend/` directories matching spec §4
- [ ] `.gitignore` includes `.env` and `ecomm.db` (and standard Python/Node ignores)
- [ ] `backend/requirements.txt` lists: `fastapi`, `uvicorn[standard]`, `sqlalchemy`, `passlib[bcrypt]`, `python-jose[cryptography]`, `python-dotenv`
- [ ] `.env.example` provided with a `SECRET_KEY` placeholder (non-real value)
- [ ] CORS middleware in `main.py` restricts `allow_origins` to `["http://localhost:5173"]`
- [ ] FastAPI app boots on port 8000 and a live axios call from the frontend origin is not blocked by CORS (Risk R5)
- [ ] No secret with a real value is committed to the repo

## Tasks
- [ ] Create monorepo directory structure (`backend/`, `frontend/`) per spec §4
- [ ] Add `.gitignore` with `.env` and `ecomm.db` before any backend code lands
- [ ] Author `backend/requirements.txt` with the six pinned dependencies
- [ ] Add `.env.example` + dotenv loading; fail-fast if `SECRET_KEY` missing
- [ ] Bootstrap `main.py` with FastAPI app + CORS restricted to localhost:5173

## Dependencies
- none

ticket.title: [Backend] Data layer & auth utilities
ticket.body:
<!-- aisdlc-key: SPEC-20260720-login-module::story::backend-data-layer-auth-utilities -->
<!-- aisdlc-hash: d3bdc066f5f17a77 -->

Implement the persistence layer (SQLAlchemy `User` model, SQLite engine, `get_db` dependency) and the reusable security primitives (bcrypt hashing, JWT create/verify). These are consumed by every auth endpoint.

**Spec-ID:** SPEC-20260720-login-module
**Depends on:** Story 1 (scaffolding)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `User` model has `id`, `email` (unique), `hashed_password`, `full_name`, `created_at`
- [ ] `database.py` creates a SQLite engine (`sqlite:///./ecomm.db`), exposes `get_db`, and runs `Base.metadata.create_all()` on startup
- [ ] `get_password_hash` produces bcrypt hashes with prefix `$2b$`; `verify_password` validates correctly
- [ ] Plaintext passwords are never persisted (US-07)
- [ ] `create_access_token` issues HS256 tokens with 30-min expiry, encoding user identity in `sub`
- [ ] `get_current_user` dependency raises HTTP 401 on missing, expired, or tampered tokens
- [ ] Pydantic schemas defined: `UserCreate`, `UserLogin`, `UserOut` (no password), `Token`
- [ ] `UserCreate` enforces minimum password length of 8 characters (OQ-4 resolved)

## Tasks
- [ ] Implement `database.py` engine + `get_db` dependency
- [ ] Implement `models.py` `User` model with unique email + `created_at` default
- [ ] Implement `schemas.py` (`UserCreate` min_length=8, `UserLogin`, `UserOut`, `Token`)
- [ ] Implement bcrypt helpers in `auth.py` (`get_password_hash`, `verify_password`)
- [ ] Implement JWT create/verify in `auth.py` (`create_access_token`, `get_current_user`)

## Dependencies
- #2

<!-- aisdlc-deps: 2 -->

ticket.title: [Backend] Auth endpoints with error handling
ticket.body:
<!-- aisdlc-key: SPEC-20260720-login-module::story::backend-auth-endpoints-error-handling -->
<!-- aisdlc-hash: a947b1b3c805d375 -->

Expose the four auth endpoints in `routers/auth.py` with correct status codes, response shapes, and error handling, wiring together the data layer and security utilities.

**Spec-ID:** SPEC-20260720-login-module
**Depends on:** Story 2 (data layer & auth utilities)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `POST /auth/register` → 201 returning `id`, `email`, `full_name`, `created_at`; no password field
- [ ] `POST /auth/register` → 409 on duplicate email (catch `IntegrityError`, Risk R3)
- [ ] `POST /auth/register` → 400/422 on missing/malformed fields, including password shorter than 8 chars
- [ ] `POST /auth/login` → 200 with `access_token` and `token_type: "bearer"` for valid credentials
- [ ] `POST /auth/login` → 401 for wrong password or unregistered email (no field-specific leakage)
- [ ] `POST /auth/logout` → 200 regardless of whether a token is supplied (stateless)
- [ ] `GET /auth/me` → 200 with user fields when a valid Bearer token is supplied
- [ ] `GET /auth/me` → 401 when token is missing, expired, or tampered
- [ ] No endpoint ever returns `hashed_password` or any bcrypt-prefixed string

## Tasks
- [ ] Implement `POST /auth/register` (hash + persist → 201; IntegrityError → 409)
- [ ] Implement `POST /auth/login` (verify → JWT 200; generic 401 on failure)
- [ ] Implement `POST /auth/logout` (stateless 200)
- [ ] Implement `GET /auth/me` (protected via `get_current_user`)

## Dependencies
- #3

<!-- aisdlc-deps: 3 -->

ticket.title: [Frontend] Scaffolding & API client
ticket.body:
<!-- aisdlc-key: SPEC-20260720-login-module::story::frontend-scaffolding-api-client -->
<!-- aisdlc-hash: 0105db8c9969228b -->

Stand up the Vite React app, routing, the shared axios client with JWT request/response interceptors, and the `ProtectedRoute` guard — the reusable auth plumbing every page depends on.

**Spec-ID:** SPEC-20260720-login-module
**Depends on:** Story 3 (auth endpoints — API contract)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Vite React app runs on port 5173 with `react-router-dom` and `axios` installed
- [ ] `BrowserRouter` with routes for `/register`, `/login`, `/dashboard`
- [ ] `api/axiosClient.js` is a single instance; request interceptor attaches `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from `localStorage["access_token"]`
- [ ] Response interceptor catches 401 globally: clears token and redirects to `/login` (US-05)
- [ ] `ProtectedRoute` redirects to `/login` when `localStorage["access_token"]` is absent, without calling `GET /auth/me`
- [ ] Auth state uses raw JWT string in `localStorage["access_token"]` only (no Redux/Zustand)

## Tasks
- [ ] Scaffold Vite React app + install `react-router-dom`, `axios`
- [ ] Configure router with `/register`, `/login`, `/dashboard` (dashboard in ProtectedRoute)
- [ ] Build `api/axiosClient.js` with Bearer request interceptor
- [ ] Add global 401 response interceptor (clear token + redirect)
- [ ] Implement `ProtectedRoute` component

## Dependencies
- #4

<!-- aisdlc-deps: 4 -->

ticket.title: [Frontend] Auth pages
ticket.body:
<!-- aisdlc-key: SPEC-20260720-login-module::story::frontend-auth-pages -->
<!-- aisdlc-hash: 5827b166d45848da -->

Build the three user-facing pages — Register, Login, Dashboard — with inline error handling for all failure modes and the logout flow.

**Spec-ID:** SPEC-20260720-login-module
**Depends on:** Story 4 (frontend scaffolding & API client)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `/register` renders a form with `full_name`, `email`, `password`; on 201 redirects to `/login`
- [ ] Duplicate email (409) shows an inline error containing "already registered"; page does not navigate
- [ ] Missing/invalid field (400/422) shows an inline validation error; stays on `/register`
- [ ] `/login` renders `email`/`password` form; on 200 stores JWT in `localStorage["access_token"]` and redirects to `/dashboard`
- [ ] Wrong/unregistered credentials (401) show inline "Invalid credentials"; no token stored
- [ ] `/dashboard` calls `GET /auth/me` on mount with Bearer header and displays user name + email (US-08)
- [ ] Logout button calls `POST /auth/logout`, clears `localStorage["access_token"]`, redirects to `/login`
- [ ] After logout, navigating back to `/dashboard` redirects to `/login`
- [ ] All form errors are rendered inline (no alert/modal)

## Tasks
- [ ] Build `RegisterPage` (success redirect + 409/400 inline errors)
- [ ] Build `LoginPage` (store JWT + redirect; 401 inline error, no token)
- [ ] Build `DashboardPage` with `GET /auth/me` displaying user info
- [ ] Implement Logout flow (+ post-logout guard redirect)
- [ ] Extract shared `AuthForm` + inline error rendering (optional)

## Dependencies
- #5

<!-- aisdlc-deps: 5 -->

ticket.title: [QA] Testing & verification
ticket.body:
<!-- aisdlc-key: SPEC-20260720-login-module::story::qa-testing-verification -->
<!-- aisdlc-hash: eb89b6a799a6f5de -->

Prove the contract and the happy path end-to-end: backend `pytest`, frontend `vitest`, security checks, and a Playwright E2E flow. Closes out the epic's quality gates.

**Spec-ID:** SPEC-20260720-login-module
**Depends on:** Stories 3 & 5

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `pytest` suite covers register (201/409/400-422), login (200/401), logout (200), `/auth/me` (200/401) and passes with 0 failures
- [ ] Test asserts stored password is a bcrypt hash (`$2b$` prefix) and never equals plaintext
- [ ] Test asserts no endpoint returns `hashed_password` or a bcrypt-prefixed string
- [ ] `vitest` suite covers form rendering, success redirects, inline errors, and `ProtectedRoute` guard; passes with 0 failures
- [ ] E2E Playwright test: register → login → dashboard → logout → confirm redirect
- [ ] No `console.error` or uncaught promise rejections during the E2E happy path
- [ ] Repo scan confirms no committed real `SECRET_KEY`; `.env` present in `.gitignore`
- [ ] API contract (status codes + response shapes) matches the spec exactly

## Tasks
- [ ] Backend `pytest` suite for all endpoint status codes (test DB)
- [ ] Backend security tests (bcrypt storage + no hash leakage)
- [ ] Frontend `vitest` suite (pages + ProtectedRoute + inline errors)
- [ ] E2E Playwright happy-path test (register → login → dashboard → logout)
- [ ] Repo secret-scan / gitignore verification

## Dependencies
- #4
- #6
